project.description: Full GraphLibraryDocument when no selector is supplied, or a bounded graph shard {blueprintId,title,entry,graph} when snapshot selectors are supplied. Character and scene production definitions are not embedded; nodes reference their manifest entities by id. null if no disk data.

assetEntities.description: Read projection of assets/manifest.json assetCatalog entities. Prompts, descriptions and current preview asset ids live here, outside blueprint.json.

revision.description: Server-authoritative blueprint revision. Pass it back as expectedRevision only for graph/rules writes.

assetRevision.description: Server-authoritative assets/manifest.json revision. Missing legacy stamps read as 0; pass it as expectedRevision for character, scene, and preview asset writes.
